svg.title: Contact Did Not Automatically Mean Conquest
svg.desc: Interactions: Trade and negotiation are forms of contact, not automatic proof of complete conquest.. Place matters: A post in one place does not establish the same authority everywhere around it.. Source limit: Treaty wording and an authors account need dated evidence of actual practice.
